book.name: Apanll Ashtachu Anu
book.title: Apanll ashtachu anu Yuwaa Apanll tputsee wanichu anoo kamankiya Wangarini

content: Nuw Wangi siyaam yandakina. Nimun kirakamun yandachima yuwaa Apanll piypa ashtachina, tárangu anootsi. Apanll waana mangush chinayaru, waanaatsi wipaa Isusoo kamanirangiya; yámandarangiya. Wasina yasaru, Apanllee wasundururi nuwap zanganeeru, nuwaa kamanirangiya yuwaa musá ashchima átu anootsi.
Ashirucha, Isusoo kuk mazinaranguri, yámandarangu anoo ichinguru paranguri, siyaatssha itsinsaru kamanchintspa.

Ashiriya, tputs nee kirakaa natstakatssin, ichingurusin mazinayarusin, Apanllsha anoo kis napchiya. Nee payukinaareesa, Apanllsha kapung istachintsa, watam in tsiyatsis nda zapshtachuwa. In k'kuz zurumaritcha. Apanll yasaru, na iyaatssha wasina kamankiya.

Zuwanllee, ¿tamarimsa siya? ¿Taaris? Nuw siyaam Ásiyshucheemis yandayaruri, kirakaa zanganchintspa. Yaktap minungich kuwiz tsimbun matayaru zanganchima. Apanll siyaam wanasir istakchu, mangeemis mapiym panachiya atina. ¡Apanll tamara! Urutamari taarangiya. Sirú uru taarangu, wandaritam na taaku, urutamaritam taachiya; pastacheeja, ndambaree. Tsimbun matayaru tamapari ashiritaa paranguri, itaru Apanll Wani Apanllpata tasasaw parangina. An Apanll Wani siyaa wanasir istachtamparee atina. Mangeemis mapiym panachtamparee.

Mishat, Isus siyaa ashtachtampari tina. Isus Waparee kuk uru payurangiya. Anumand tsiparangiya. Tsipayaru, yusur támarangiya. Isusumari ashirangiya. Uwma támeeru, iyaatstam ituyamachiya. Waamari kasiriya. Tsapurunasshuchee urkar ichinguru kasiriya.
Isus kizpurcha; iyaa kizpur chinarangiya. Waanpata ursiri iyaam tumashirini tuwaparangiya. Iyamand yutaritshishirini tuwaparangiya.
Sheeru, waamata tiptsir iyaa ínarangiya.
Apareetsi uru chinapana átu ashirangiya. Ashirucha, urutamari Isusootsi, Apanllee Wip kizpur chinayani atashina. Mishat, Isus uru wamari kasiru taachpa atitamana.

Mazinangantsa; Isus msasush yusur kuschiya musásirita. Tputs ichingurusin kamiran pangchinllinaya. Isusoo kayungarangtaatssin, ngatarangtaatssin, pangchinllinaya. Tsapurunasshuch ztaru pachinllinaya. Pakeersin, sitatstee táchinllinaya; mang' ksuh ashchinllinaya; punirus musáchinllinaya,
Apanll waana ashchiya tina.
Apanll waana ateeja; Nuwaanitari taarina. Nuwamari kasikina, átcha Apanllee. Apanll urutari taarangiya. Sirú uru taarangu, wandaritam na taaku, urutamaritam taachiya. Watacha iy Aparini.
Mazinangtsa; yuwaa pamasakpazi ashirangiwa anoo kamanchintspa

Nuw siyaa zuwanlltana. Nuw siyaptatam Isus wamin kiyung kachiykina. Washunandari Isustanicha tiptsirini. Isusoo iy kurakartanicha. Isusoo kutakuni, nda sambaytakani. Apanllee kuk kamaniranguri, Isus wamin nuwaa kiyung yachakanda. Isusoo kuk nda kapeetaranguri, nuwaatssha tsurush wayarangana tumanamaama. Tsuru sura Pátamoscha.

Anush taaruri, mangi tsípatara ashku, pamazukpaz ashirangina. Maacheetsi zapan parangina. Domingosh zar ashirangina, zar yuwash Isusoom uru shaniykini anshu. Ashiranguri, kushipi k'kuz kizpur kimarangiya; wakar wits tamapari ashiru zunganeerangiya.

Nuwapat tsiyatku, Kirakamun ichinguru yandangcha; tárangiya. Yuwaa pakchish anoo izuuru yandangcha. Yandayarush, nuwap tputsiri zanganingcha. Yaktap tsimbun matayaru amb zanganingi. Ipísuptam, Esmirinaptam, Pergamuptam, Tíyatíraptam, Sartísaptam, Filadelfiyaptam, Láwdisaptam, aship zanganingi; tárangiya nuwaatsi.
Táyaranllu, kizpur punirustaranguri, ¿Chaka átar? aturi, natpunurangina. Natpunuyaruri, nambarin ashtamaru, itaru kapung parangina. Tsimbun matayaru orpat tinamaama kizpur wanasiri parangina.

Itaru, ipusunandush tputs ashiru xiyxeew ashirangiya. Tputseem kinarangu anparee, tárangina. Wazuran kamartarangu, watsimun kandanirangiya. Watitkurish wamarimun maachi orpa tinaru kichpurangiya. [Kizpur kurak tamapari ashiru yararangiya.]
Muchsha mburshinandari opeeja pur tamapari ashirangiya.
Wachsha sumas ashiru kurakurtangat ashirangiya.

Watssha chumbichumbtar ashirangiya. Ngusambpaz chumbeepimashee sumasush pshtayaruch, kizpur chumbeeptaru ashiru an parangina. Itaru, tsiyatku, kung tawangur zaw átar ashtaru ashiru kapung kimarangiya.
Uwishsha mbutsutsinungich tsangach ashiru tsimbun matayaru payurangiya. Kukushsha mchit ashiru shitungta ashirangiya. Ningich wawits arangich wawitstam mchit ashiru an shitungarangiya.
Wansha kizpur 'sineerangiya. Zar wachamureetskachu kizpur zataru 'sinitaru ashiru 'sineerangu.

¡Maya! anoo paranguri, kizpur punirangina. Uwanungiri wats tum ashirangina. Tsipar tamapari ashiruri tamuramchina. Sheeru, uweetssha mbutsutsinung paxayeeru, nuwamun wayarangiya. Nuwaatssha: Punirinllpa, tárangiya. Nuwtanda. Nuw ichtakachuri taarangina. Nuw urutamari taaki antana,
tárangiya.
Sirú tsiparangitaati, itaru kchittana. Urutamari taakina nuwa. Tsipatsee izuuru kasiyana. Tsapush wantsush tumaneeri kasayana. [Nuw Apanlltana Wipi.]

Ashiri mazinangandama; yuwaa pakeenllish anoo ichinguru kamaningcha. Kirakamun yandanlla; kamapshirinllpa. Sirú parangish anoo yandangtamcha. Zapish yusur pangchish anootstam yandanlla. Na in maacheetsi wasina shiyaam yámandayaruri, shiysha yasayarush, yandanlla tina.

Itaru, shiysha tsangach payuri anoo mashangandama, tárangu, nuwsha ¿Mayaama tsangach ashtar? táranguri, uwsha: nambarin watacha tputsirina, yuw nuwaa mangoonkana ancha. Itaru, tsangachsha watach Apari nuw kamachtashi, tárangiya. Apari wámachtash yuw tsimbun matayaru tputsiri taakana anoo ksutkana ancha, tsimbun matayaru yaktash taakana anu. Mishat, nambarinsha watacha tputsirina, yuw nuwaa mangoonkana ancha, tárangiya Apanll Wip nuwaatsi. Apanllee Wip mirinish paranguri ashirangiya.
